title: Co-Expression of PdxJ Increases Soluble EnzQ Production Without Detectable Binding to Purified EnzQ
authors: Lena Sato, Quinn Nyx, and Omar Bren | Model Protein Interaction Facility
research_question: Does PdxJ co-expression increase soluble EnzQ, and do purified PdxJ and EnzQ form a stable complex?
key_findings: Soluble EnzQ increased from 2.4 to 7.1 mg/L
No stable binding was detected by three assays
numeric_findings: binding not detected up to 50 uM PdxJ
conclusion: PdxJ improves soluble production but does not remain stably bound to purified EnzQ under tested conditions.
critical_negations: A transient interaction was not demonstrated
Total expression did not increase threefold
forbidden_claims: PdxJ binds EnzQ with high affinity
